_comment: ILM policy for the deception-events data stream. Values in days of retention; the bootstrap script (deploy/elastic/scripts/bootstrap-security.sh --apply-ilm) reads ILM_DECEPTION_EVENTS_DAYS from .env and this file serves as canonical default. Hot: rollover at 50GB or 30d. Delete: 30d by default (OVERRIDE with env).
_note: delete_searchable_snapshot: true only applies if searchable snapshots (paid) were configured; with basic license the action is ignored and simply deletes. Keep under basic license.
